set system host-name client002.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.3.3/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Configure protocol versions for SSH services.

set system login user root authenticatio.command: set system login user root authentication-tries 4
set system login user root authenticatio.explanation: Configure the number of authentication attempts that you want to log in.

set system services ssh root-login deny.command: set system services ssh root-login deny
set system services ssh root-login deny.explanation: Configure whether root users are allowed to log in through SSH.

parameters.name: root-login
parameters.explanation: Whether root is allowed to log in, e.g. deny.

set system services ssh connection-limit.explanation: Configure the maximum number of connections to SSH services.

parameters.name: connection-limit
parameters.explanation: Maximum number of connections to SSH services.
